Chapter 480: Chapter 17 The Invincible Lin Yuan (Subscribe Please)

Seventh Layer of Heaven, silent and soundless.

All the Supreme Immortal Kings who were fighting, whether they were born during the Era of Three Thousand Dao States or the Prehistoric Era, all ceased their combat.

They subconsciously looked towards the figure who, with absolute brutality and absolute strength, tore the barrier between the Seventh Layer of Heaven and the Eighth Layer of Heaven.

In the Spirit Realm’s Nine Heavens, from the First Layer of Heaven to the Second Layer of Heaven, from the Second Layer of Heaven to the Third Layer of Heaven… from the Seventh Layer of Heaven to the Eighth Layer of Heaven…

There are two paths.

One is to follow the fixed entrances between each layer of heaven, which would allow one to ascend to the next layer.

...

However, at these fixed entrances, numerous challenges exist, such as the Endless Wind Calamity, the Ninefold Thunder Tribulation, and so on.

The other is to not use the fixed entrances and directly tear open the barrier between the layers of heaven to climb to a higher level.

However—

The barriers between the layers of heaven are not so easily torn apart.

Even for a Supreme Immortal King, to tear the barrier between the First Layer of Heaven and the Second Layer of Heaven requires considerable effort—far less convenient than simply entering through the entrance.

And the barriers between each layer of heaven are more robust than the last; a normal Supreme Immortal King might expend some effort to tear open the barrier between the First Layer of Heaven and the Second Layer of Heaven.

But the barrier from the Second Layer of Heaven to the Third Layer of Heaven would require a Supreme Immortal King to give it his all.

As for the barrier between the Third Layer of Heaven and the Fourth Layer of Heaven? An ordinary Supreme Immortal King simply cannot manage it.

In this battle to ascend to the heavens, the Open Heaven Immortal King and Supreme Immortal King from the Era of Three Thousand Dao States chose to ‘ascend’ at the entrance leading to the Eighth Layer of Heaven.

Because that is the simplest way, as for forcibly tearing the barrier between the Seventh Layer of Heaven and the Eighth Layer of Heaven… the Open Heaven Immortal King, the Supreme Immortal King, and more than twenty other Supreme Immortal Kings working together.

It could indeed be possible, but it would at least take several days and nights,

With that amount of time, the Supreme Immortal Kings from the Prehistoric Era residing in the Eighth Layer of Heaven would have long been aware, and likewise would have prepared at the barrier above, making it no different from starting a battle from the entrance.

The Open Heaven Immortal King, the Supreme Immortal King, and more than twenty other Supreme Immortal Kings working together, would need several days and nights to barely manage to tear open the barrier between the Seventh Layer of Heaven and the Eighth Layer of Heaven.

The barrier between the Sixth Layer Heaven and the Seventh Layer of Heaven, although not as tough as the former, would certainly also require more than twenty Supreme Immortal Kings giving their full effort for the better part of a day or even two days to hope to tear it open.

But just a moment ago.

The figure that suddenly arrived, how long did it take to shred the barrier between the Sixth Layer Heaven and the Seventh Layer of Heaven? A breath? Or merely an instant?

And this figure, it seems, did not only tear apart the barrier between the Sixth Layer Heaven and the Seventh Layer of Heaven; the barriers of the five major layers beneath were all brutally shredded without a moment’s pause.

This power is too terrifying; even for the likes of the Open Heaven Immortal King and Supreme Immortal King, such formidable Supreme Immortal Kings, it caused their hearts to tremble at this moment.

Furthermore, in the moment that figure appeared, an invisible and terrifying Qi and Blood Domain covered one-tenth of the Seventh Layer of Heaven, enveloping all the Supreme Immortal Kings within it.

Compared to the shock of the other Supreme Immortal Kings, Lingxu Immortal King felt almost suffocated at this moment; merely approaching that figure caused the higher Power of Creation in his body to fall into dead silence, not to mention the six other ordinary Powers of Creation.

“You, who exactly are you?”

“Which era’s powerful figure are you?”

Lingxu Immortal King asked tremblingly. As a Supreme Immortal King from the Prehistoric Era, Lingxu Immortal King understood that the Spirit Realm had gone through one era after another over countless millennia.

The Prehistoric Era? The Era of Three Thousand Dao States—those were just the two most recent eras.

Before these two eras, there were even more ancient and inscrutable eras.

“Who am I?”

“Just now, didn’t you sneak attack me?”

Lin Yuan glanced at Lingxu Immortal King and spoke calmly.

The Taiji Primordial Spirit, under the Great Destructive Force of Lingxu Immortal King’s Third Realm, transformed into nothingness. Although it was partly because Lin Yuan dismissed it intentionally, it was indeed due to Lingxu Immortal King.

At the moment the Taiji Primordial Spirit was sneak attacked, Lin Yuan’s True Body left the Martial Temple and directly entered the Nine Heavens, following the principle that the shortest distance between two points is a straight line; he traversed through various marvels and phenomena, layer barriers, and arrived here.

“Sneak attack you?”

Lingxu Immortal King was slightly stunned.

Immediately, his face showed an incredulous expression.

The Martial Ancestor earlier, was it this person in front of him?

Lingxu Immortal King found it hard to believe. The Martial Ancestor’s strength was indeed very strong, even surpassing the Open Heaven Immortal King and Supreme Immortal King.

But that was it.

In a one-on-one situation, even without sneak attacking, Lingxu Immortal King was confident he could suppress the Martial Ancestor.

The reason for the sneak attack was merely to resolve the fight quickly and, as much as possible, erase this unstable factor that was the Martial Ancestor.

For Lingxu Immortal King, who had lived through the long years, he no longer cared about whether it involved sneak attacking or not.

The surrounding Supreme Immortal Kings were also closely watching Lin Yuan.

They couldn’t help it; Lin Yuan’s method of appearance was too terrifying, with formidable barriers of the heaven, the appearance was like mere thin paper in his presence.

It was utterly unimaginable.

“The Martial Ancestor, he is the Martial Ancestor?”

“How is that possible? No, wait, the aura is similar, they could indeed be the same person.”

…

Many Supreme Immortal Kings, especially those from the Era of Three Thousand Dao States, initially were utterly dumbfounded, but as they carefully felt it out, they vaguely discovered that the Martial Ancestor, who they had good relations with, indeed had similarities in aura with the person before them.

This similarity was fundamental, possessing the same Power of Creation, as well as that vast power similar to the World’s Force of the Spirit Realm.

The difference is that the earlier Martial Ancestor, who possessed that type of World’s Force, if it were from the Lower Realms’ one Dao Province,
